notes: TurboMusic is the app the engine's modules were first taken from; the engine is now the common source, so everything starts identical. TurboMusic also owns the library domain (packages/core, packages/server, the pages), which is not in the engine. Port improvements to a module back to the engine (see its CLAUDE.md). Themes: the turbothemes package is installed from the engine repo (pnpm git dependency on themes/); the separate turbothemes repository is retired.
